what: hostile review of lane verification of the Codex consult (w_p obstruction, Res membership, constant-bracket, four-letter, insertion/gluing lemmas, computations)
delegate: claude CLI (DELEGATE_MODELS.json claude: claude-opus-5-5, effort max); cross-vendor relative to the current OpenAI parent (gpt-6.1-sol). Lane worker is Claude-family.
command: claude --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort max --settings {ultracode,enableWorkflows} --no-chrome --tools Read,Glob,Grep --permission-mode dontAsk --no-session-persistence --output-format json --json-schema <schema.json> -p "$(cat prompt.txt)"
required_fixes: verify-consult.md 1a, R' sentence: replace 'keeps one reflection value (at most p-2 copies), so >= p+2 > p-3 deletions' with 'at most max(p-2, 4) <= p-1 copies (sigma_2 has 4 copies, which exceeds p-2 at p = 5), so >= p+1 > p-3 deletions'.

verify-consult.md Sec. 2, edge-case flag: record that the consult's proof covers m = p-1 unchanged. The second-family heights 1..p are distinct residues, including 0. The separator vanishes at (C+2x, 0) because that point lies on L. For x != 0 the bracket is non-full iff C != -2x, and C = -2x gives a direct identity 2p-subword. Also correct 'only if m+1 <= p-1' to 'iff m+1 <= p', and replace the relevance argument: by (c6), constant runs in Res have <= p-1 letters, so m <= (p-1)/2.

Counter-controls: either add a parity-preserving isolation control (e.g. sigma_0^{p-2} rho_1^{p-3} sigma_1^{p-2} rho_1^{p-2} sigma_2^4 rho_1^4, F = 2p), or reword the reading to say that short_first_rot breaks isolation and the even-F parity together, so it does not test isolation alone.

Provenance: regenerate the p = 13 results with verify_consult.py (same schema), or archive the driver that actually produced consult_verification.p13.json. Record the outputs behind 'p = 5: 9 with blocks <= 6', 'p = 7: 12 with blocks <= 9' and 'eight-letter depth 3 at p = 3, 13', or remove those claims.
Reword the four-letter computation claim: the 'always full' shapes are exhaustive only at p <= 7 and were sampled (3000) at p = 11.

Restrict the 'Consequence' sentence (and the consult's 'uniformly bounded unit lengths') to tilings whose top-level blocks have bounded length. Tilings in which bounded units are nested into long top-level blocks are not covered by the theorem.
scope_note: Validity of the bounded-short-unit obstruction and the listed lemmas only; not a proof of ordered Olson for D_2p; not novelty.
